chronologies.date: “after a reign of thirty-five years, Astyages lost his crown”
chronologies.citation: Herodotus, Histories 1.130 (tr. George Rawlinson; Roman Roads Media etext, 2013), p. 60 (PDF p. 62)
chronologies.note: DERIVED (not Herodotus's figure): 595/594 BC − 35 = 560/559 BC, the CFAH Era of Cyrus (AP-7). Total Deioces→Astyages' fall = 53 + 22 + 40 + 35 = 150 years (CFAH-5 makes the same sum). Agrees with CFAH AP-7 (560/559 BC). Generations (provisional) dates Cyrus's founding of the Medo-Persian empire to 550 BC, 10 years later; CFAH-5 explains this as Herodotus counting to Cyrus's coregency (560) and Ctesias to the defeat of Astyages (550).
